compare.advice: Keep your specialist software for bookkeeping, files and billing. We build the layer in front of it: everything clients deliver, sign or look up. And if your software vendor's portal is enough for you, we will tell you so in the first call.

faq.q: Does this replace DATEV or our practice software?
faq.a: No. The portal complements it and hands data over via an interface or prepares it for import. Bookkeeping, files and billing stay where they are.

faq.q: What does a client portal cost?
faq.a: From around €7,400 for login, documents, status and messages, with workflows, approvals and AI receipt recognition from around €12,900. You get the fixed price after the prototype.

faq.q: How is confidentiality protected?
faq.a: Data is stored encrypted in the EU, with roles, permissions and an audit log. We sign a data processing agreement; the confidentiality undertaking required for holders of professional secrets is settled with you before the project starts.

faq.q: Is client data used for AI training?
faq.a: No. We use services with data processing agreements and no training on your data. The AI makes suggestions, the firm decides.

faq.q: Will clients actually use it?
faq.a: In our experience, yes – when it is easier than an email: a photo with the phone, done. That is why we start with a pilot group and adjust the checklists before everyone moves over.

faq.q: How long does implementation take?
faq.a: You get the clickable prototype after 7 days. Onboarding is ready in three to four weeks, a portal in five to eight weeks.

faq.q: Do clients have to install an app?
faq.a: No. The portal runs in the browser on any device. Anyone who likes can add it to their home screen like an app.

faq.q: Does this also work for coaches and training providers?
faq.a: Yes. For KlarVoran, a job and application coaching provider in Rhine-Main, we built the website and initial-call funnel.

steps.title: Approve
steps.text: One look, one click. You decide per workflow what may go out automatically and what you want to see first.

steps.title: The result lands where it belongs

calc.title: What does routine cost?
calc.text: Five minutes per reply sounds harmless. Twenty times a day it is almost four working days a month.
calc.note: On top come operation from €49 a month and usually low usage costs for the AI services, which we estimate in advance.
calc.whenNot: If a task only comes up twice a week or is different every time, automation isn't worth it. And where a mistake would be expensive – legal advice, price commitments, diagnoses – the AI stays at the draft and a person decides.

phases.title: Expansion

faq.q: What does a workflow cost?
faq.a: Between €590 and €1,490 one-off, plus operation from €49 per month and usually low usage costs for the AI services.

faq.q: Is our data used for AI training?
faq.a: No. We use services with data processing agreements and no training on your data, with EU hosting where possible.

faq.q: What if the AI makes a mistake?
faq.a: That is why every workflow starts with approval: you see every draft before it goes out. Only what has proven itself runs automatically – and everything is logged.

faq.q: Do we need new software for this?
faq.a: No. The workflows run in your existing tools: inbox, calendar, accounting, CRM.

faq.q: Does AI replace our staff?
faq.a: In our projects AI mainly takes over routine – leaving more time for customers.

faq.q: What do you build the workflows with?
faq.a: With n8n for stable automations between your tools, with monitoring and an alert if something gets stuck.

faq.q: Who is winsym.ai?
faq.a: Our technology partner from Kuala Lumpur, specialised in AI transformation for SMEs. We do the implementation for you in Germany.

privacy.formsText: When you contact us via the funnel or the pricing calculator, we store your details (name, email, optionally phone, company, message, selected services, budget range and calculation) to process your enquiry (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). The data is stored in a Supabase database (hosted in the EU, Frankfurt region) and processed via a self-hosted n8n workflow: a notification to us and a confirmation email to you. We only store your IP address as a salted hash to protect against spam. If no contract results, we delete enquiries after 24 months at the latest.
privacy.calendlyText: We only load the booking calendar after you click. Data is then transferred to Calendly LLC (USA) (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR, EU-US Data Privacy Framework).
privacy.videosText: Preview clips are hosted on our own server. Links to YouTube only open in a new tab when you click them.
